messages:
IncidentBot: ALERT: Service: inference-redis-pool - queue_backlog > 1200 for 5m. Paging primary oncall. https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD12345 :warning: 
Alex Kim: Oncall here — picking this up. Thanks bot. Checking dashboards.
Maya Patel: FYI I'm on secondary for the night. Ping me if you need escalation or infra touches. :handshake:  
Alex Kim: Observed sustained write latency to redis-shard-3 and KV cache misses spiking. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/abcd/inference?from=now-30m
Samir Rao: Could be a memory pressure OOM on cache host, I saw a similar blip last week. I'll grab host metrics.
Alex Kim: Running basic checks now. If we need a quick mitigation, we can flip routing to replica pool (read-only) to reduce write pressure, but that risks stale cache. Thoughts?
Lina Gomez: Runbook for queue backlog + cache fallback is here: https://runbooks.redwood.internal/oncall/queue_backlog_and_kv_fallback.md — follow the 'safest mitigation' path first.
Alex Kim: Copying safe steps from runbook: 1) increase consumer concurrency (if under limit) 2) enable short-term backpressure on non-critical traffic 3) schedule a rolling restart of cache replica.
Maya Patel: For quick traffic control, we can apply rate-limit on low-priority routes: /embeddings/batch and /async/generate. I can patch the routing policy if you want.
Alex Kim: Please do that, Maya. Patch should include a 20% throttling on /embeddings/batch for 15m window.
Maya Patel: On it. Pushing policy now. Patch command: 
```bash
# k8s config patch (example)
kubectl -n redwood apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: routing.redwood/v1
kind: RateLimit
metadata:
  name: throttling-embeddings-night
spec:
  route: /embeddings/batch
  limit: 80%
  duration: 15m
EOF
```
Maya Patel: Patch applied. Confirming via console. :white_check_mark: 
Alex Kim: Thanks. Samir any immediate infra actions?
Samir Rao: I'm ssh-ing into redis-shard-3 host to check memory/IO. Running: `htop`, `iostat -x 1 5`, `docker stats | grep redis`
Samir Rao: Disk IO looks elevated, memory at 92% (redis processes at 65% of that). There's also a surge of ephemeral connections from retriers.
Lina Gomez: If retriers are spamming the cache, runbook suggests temp banning IPs at edge (nginx) and forcing clients to exponential backoff. See section "throttling noisy callers" in runbook.
Alex Kim: Can we identify the noisy client? Samir, can you capture top incoming IPs/conns?
Samir Rao: yes: `ss -tn | awk '{print $5}' | cut -d: -f1 | sort | uniq -c | sort -nr | head` shows a handful of IPs from our partner ingestion region. Pushing firewall rule to drop excessive connections.
Samir Rao: Also restarting redis process gracefully on shard-3 per runbook: 
```bash
# graceful restart
redis-cli -h redis-shard-3 SHUTDOWN NOSAVE || true
systemctl start redis || docker run ...
```
Samir Rao: Restart triggered, monitoring reconnection.
IncidentBot: NOTE: Incident assigned to Alex Kim (primary). PagerDuty incident PD12345 created and labeled "cache-backlog-night".
Alex Kim: After restart, backlog abated from 1400 -> 300 in ~120s. Latency back to normal 95th p50->p95 stable. Closing mitigation loop: need postmortem and follow-ups.
Maya Patel: Good catch. I'll leave the routing throttle for another 10m then remove. Also opening a follow-up ticket to harden retrier behavior on partner ingestion.
Lina Gomez: Follow-ups: (1) increase redis eviction buffer for shard-3 (2) add smarter client-side backoff to ingestion SDK (3) run a load test on replica switchover. I'll file RFCs.
Samir Rao: I'll add host-level IO monitoring and an alert when ephemeral connections spike > 3000 in 1m.
Alex Kim: Oncall handoff note for next shift: primary-> Maya Patel at 07:00 UTC, leaving a quick checklist: 1) verify shard-3 ttl/eviction settings 2) confirm no more retrier IPs blocked 3) check Grafana panels for queue_backlog and redis_io. Link: https://confluence.redwood.internal/pages/Oncall-Handoffs
Maya Patel: I got the handoff. Leaving myself as primary in the schedule. I'll follow up with infra tomorrow.
Alex Kim: Closing thread. Incident severity set to S2, customer impact: transient increased latency for embeddings/async; no data loss. Postmortem owner: Lina.
PagerDuty Bot: Incident PD12345 resolved by Alex Kim at 2024-06-15T04:08:19Z. :tada: 
Maya Patel: thx all, great quick coordination. :heart:
